title: Atlassian Jira and Confluence to Oyatie Workspace cutover

milestones: M1 Jira issue type, workflow scheme, and permission scheme inventory complete
M2 Confluence spaces exported with attachments
M3 notes µservice mapping signed for every Confluence space
M5 Atlassian site read-only and Oyatie Workspace active

SOC 2 CC8.1 change management and CC6.6 access-control evidence
GDPR Articles 30 and 32 for employee and customer data in work items and pages
SEC Rule 17a-4(f) WORM retention for regulated engineering communications where enabled
ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A 5.37 documented operating procedures and A 8.15 logging
